    • unitsPerMechRot

      public double unitsPerMechRot
      how many units per (one) mech rotation Ratio of units to rotor for this talon. units * by this ratio should be the rotors. >1 is reduction

    • conventionalPerSubsystemUnit

      public double conventionalPerSubsystemUnit
      Scale to convert **one subsystem unit** to the chosen conventional unit (meters for linear, degrees for angular). Examples: - If subsystem unit is mm → 0.001 m/mm - If subsystem unit is cm → 0.01 m/cm - If subsystem unit is rad → 57.2957795 deg/rad - If subsystem unit is already m or deg → 1.0
